steps.caption: Protection previews
steps.narration: Here's what happens between a preview and a write to Google.

steps.caption: Ready for review
steps.narration: A new preview is Ready for review.

steps.caption: Applied
steps.narration: One that was confirmed and written shows Applied.

steps.caption: An expired preview
steps.narration: Previews expire. An expired one can't be confirmed; you prepare a new one.

steps.caption: Review preview
steps.narration: Open a preview with Review preview.

steps.caption: When it expires
steps.narration: It says how many operations it holds and when it expires.

steps.selector: [role="dialog"] button:has-text("Select this preview for bulk confirmation")
steps.caption: Select for confirmation
steps.narration: Select this preview for bulk confirmation adds it to the selection and closes the preview.

steps.selector: label:has-text("I reviewed the selected previews") input
steps.caption: I reviewed the selected previews
steps.narration: Tick that you reviewed the selected previews.

steps.caption: Confirm selected previews
steps.narration: Only now can you choose Confirm selected previews. We'll stop here, so nothing is written.

steps.caption: Re-checked before writing
steps.narration: Each account is read again right before anything is written. If it changed, nothing is written.

steps.caption: Preview reversal
steps.narration: An applied change can be reversed, through its own preview: Preview reversal of selected applied changes.

steps.selector: p:has-text("Reversal stops if the account has changed")
steps.caption: Reversal stops on change
steps.narration: Reversal stops if the account has changed since the write.

steps.caption: Menu: Protection previews
steps.narration: Protection previews is in the Agency Ads and LSA menu on the left.

youtube.title: How a Google Ads change is confirmed and reversed | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of what the ConstructHUB Agency Ads & LSA manager does around every write to Google: previews that expire, a review box you tick before Confirm selected previews is available, a re-check of each account before anything is written, and a reversal that runs through its own preview.
